# LAMMPS input script for Fe grain boundary tension simulation
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style eam/fs
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Energy minimization
fix box_relax all box/relax x 0 z 0
minimize 1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
unfix box_relax

# Define groups for fixed regions
group top region top
group bottom region bottom
group mobile subtract all top bottom

# Set up output
variable strain equal "(ly - v_L0)/v_L0"
variable stress_xx equal "pxx*0.0001"  # Convert from bars to GPa
variable stress_yy equal "pyy*0.0001"
variable stress_zz equal "pzz*0.0001"

# Initialize variables
variable L0 equal ly
variable strain_rate equal 0.001
variable N_steps equal 1000
variable delta_strain equal ${strain_rate}/${N_steps}

# Output file
fix output all print 10 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain.txt screen no

# Deformation loop
label loop
variable i loop ${N_steps}
    # Increment strain
    displace_atoms top move 0.0 ${delta_strain} 0.0
    displace_atoms bottom move 0.0 -${delta_strain} 0.0
    
    # Minimize at each step
    minimize 1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
    
next i
jump SELF loop

# End simulation
write_dump all custom dump.lammpstrj id type x y z

# LAMMPS input script for Fe grain boundary tension simulation
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style eam/fs
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000

# Define regions and groups
variable ymax equal bound(all,ymax)
variable ymin equal bound(all,ymin)
region top block INF INF $(v_ymax*0.9) $(v_ymax) INF INF
region bottom block INF INF $(v_ymin) $(v_ymin*0.1) INF INF
group top_fixed region top
group bottom_fixed region bottom
group mobile subtract all top_fixed bottom_fixed

# Output setup
variable tmp equal ly
variable L0 equal ${tmp}
variable strain equal (ly-v_L0)/v_L0
variable p11 equal pxx
variable p22 equal pyy
variable p33 equal pzz
variable stress_xx equal v_p11*0.0001
variable stress_yy equal v_p22*0.0001
variable stress_zz equal v_p33*0.0001

# Deformation parameters
variable srate equal 0.0001
variable steps equal 1000
variable dl equal v_srate*v_L0/v_steps

# Output to file
fix out all print 10 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain.txt

# Run deformation
label loop
variable i loop ${steps}
    # Displace top and bottom
    displace_atoms top_fixed move 0 ${dl} 0
    displace_atoms bottom_fixed move 0 -${dl} 0
    
    # Fix boundaries
    fix 1 top_fixed setforce 0 0 0
    fix 2 bottom_fixed setforce 0 0 0
    
    # Minimize
    minimize 1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
    
    # Clean up fixes
    unfix 1
    unfix 2
next i
jump SELF loop

# Final dump
write_dump all custom dump.final id type x y z

# LAMMPS input script for Fe grain boundary tensile test
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style eam/fs
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Energy minimization
fix 1 all box/relax x 0.0 z 0.0
minimize 1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
unfix 1

# Define groups for fixed regions and delete far atoms
group edge_atoms delete
group fixed_bottom delete
group fixed_top delete

# Setup for tensile deformation
variable strain equal 0.0
variable strain_rate equal 0.001
variable N_steps equal 1000
variable cur_step equal 0

# Output settings
variable stress_xx equal pxx*1.0e-4  # Convert from bars to GPa
variable stress_yy equal pyy*1.0e-4
variable stress_zz equal pzz*1.0e-4
variable tmp equal v_strain
fix data all print 1 "${tmp} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain.txt screen no

# Main deformation loop
label loop_strain
  variable disp equal ly*${strain_rate}
  displace_atoms fixed_top move 0 ${disp} 0
  displace_atoms fixed_bottom move 0 -${disp} 0
  minimize 1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
  variable strain equal ${strain}+${strain_rate}
  variable cur_step equal ${cur_step}+1
  if "${cur_step} < ${N_steps}" then "jump SELF loop_strain"

# LAMMPS input script for Al tensile test

# Initialization
units           metal
dimension       3
boundary        p p p
atom_style      atomic

# Define crystal structure
read_data       Al.data
replicate       10 10 10

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/alloy
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Al_Zhou04.eam.alloy Al

# Define compute and output settings
compute         stress all pressure NULL virial
variable        strain equal "(lx - v_L0)/v_L0"
variable        L0 equal ${lx}
variable        stress_xx equal "c_stress[1]/10000"  # Convert to GPa
variable        stress_yy equal "c_stress[2]/10000"
variable        stress_zz equal "c_stress[3]/10000"

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Initialize velocities and equilibrate
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Run equilibration (20 ps)
timestep        0.001
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press pxx pyy pzz lx ly lz
run             20000

unfix           1

# Reset box length for strain calculation
variable        L0 equal ${lx}

# Apply tensile deformation
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 y 0.0 0.0 1.0 z 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix             2 all deform 1 x erate 0.01 units box remap x

# Output strain and stress
fix             3 all print 100 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file strain_stress.txt

# Run deformation (20 ps)
run             20000

arguments.content:
# LAMMPS input script for Σ5(310) STGB in Aluminum

# Initialize simulation
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create simulation box and crystal structure
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 30 0 30 0 30
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 region box

# Define upper and lower regions
region upper block 0 30 15 30 0 30
region lower block 0 30 0 15 0 30

# Set lattice orientations
orient upper x 0 3 1 y 0 -1 3 z 1 0 0
orient lower x 0 3 -1 y 0 1 3 z 1 0 0

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Delete overlapping atoms
delete_atoms overlap 0.35 upper lower

# Compute properties
compute csym all centro/atom fcc
compute pe all pe/atom

# First minimization
minimize 1.0e-15 1.0e-15 5000 5000

# Save initial minimized configuration
dump d1 all custom 1 dump.minimized id type x y z c_csym c_pe
dump_modify d1 sort id
run 0
undump d1

# Second minimization with box relaxation
fix 1 all box/relax z 0.0
minimize 1.0e-15 1.0e-15 5000 5000
unfix 1

# Write final configuration
write_data final.data

# Calculate energies for GB energy
variable E_bulk equal -3.360000
variable N_atoms equal count(all)
variable E_total equal pe
variable E_gb equal (v_E_total - v_N_atoms*v_E_bulk)/(2*lx*lz)
variable E_gb_mjm2 equal v_E_gb*16021.7733  # Convert from eV/Å² to mJ/m²

print "GB_Energy_mJ_per_m2 = ${E_gb_mjm2}"

import numpy as np

# Read the temperature profile data
data = np.loadtxt('temp_profile.dat')

# Average over time (skip first 1000 timesteps for better steady-state)
temp_profile = np.mean(data[10:], axis=0)

# Calculate temperature gradient (dT/dz) in the middle region
# Exclude hot and cold regions, focus on linear region
z = np.linspace(0, 20, 20)  # 20 bins
middle_start = 2  # Start after hot region
middle_end = 9    # End before cold region

# Linear fit to get temperature gradient
z_middle = z[middle_start:middle_end]
T_middle = temp_profile[middle_start:middle_end]
gradient = np.polyfit(z_middle, T_middle, 1)[0]

# Read the log file to get energy exchange rates
with open('thermal_conductivity.log', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Get the last 10000 steps of energy exchange
energy_lines = [line for line in lines if len(line.split()) == 7][-10:]
energy_data = np.array([line.split() for line in energy_lines], dtype=float)

# Calculate heat flux
# Energy per time through cross-sectional area
# Box dimensions are 10x10, so area is 100 in LJ units
hot_energy = np.mean(energy_data[:, 5])  # f_hot_thermostat
cold_energy = np.mean(energy_data[:, 6])  # f_cold_thermostat
heat_flux = abs(hot_energy) / (100 * 0.005)  # Divide by area and timestep

# Calculate thermal conductivity using Fourier's law
# κ = -J / (dT/dz)
thermal_conductivity = abs(heat_flux / gradient)

# Save the result
with open('thermal_conductivity_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(thermal_conductivity))

import numpy as np

# Read heat flux data
flux_data = np.loadtxt('heat_flux.dat')
steps = flux_data[:, 0]
E_hot = flux_data[:, 1]
E_cold = flux_data[:, 2]

# Calculate heat flux (energy per unit time per unit area)
dt = 0.005  # timestep from simulation
area = 10 * 10  # cross-sectional area
dE = E_hot[-1] - E_hot[0]  # energy change over production run
time = dt * (steps[-1] - steps[0])
J = abs(dE) / (time * area)  # heat flux

# Read temperature profile data
temp_profile = np.loadtxt('temp_profile.dat')
z = np.linspace(0, 20, temp_profile.shape[1])  # z coordinates
avg_temp = np.mean(temp_profile[-100:, :], axis=0)  # average over last 100 frames

# Calculate temperature gradient
# Focus on the linear region between hot and cold reservoirs (z = 1 to 10)
mask = (z >= 1) & (z <= 10)
z_linear = z[mask]
T_linear = avg_temp[mask]
dT_dz = np.polyfit(z_linear, T_linear, 1)[0]  # slope of temperature profile

# Calculate thermal conductivity using Fourier's law: J = -k * dT/dz
k = -J / dT_dz

# Save the result
with open('thermal_conductivity.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(k))

import numpy as np

# Calculate thermal conductivity from the simulation data
def calculate_thermal_conductivity():
    # Read the log file to get the temperature difference
    with open('thermal_conductivity.log', 'r') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    
    # Parse the last portion of the log file for steady state
    temp_hot = []
    temp_cold = []
    for line in lines[-200:]:  # Last 200 lines
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith('#'):
            try:
                parts = line.split()
                if len(parts) >= 4:  # Ensure we have enough columns
                    temp_hot.append(float(parts[2]))  # temp_hot column
                    temp_cold.append(float(parts[3]))  # temp_cold column
            except:
                continue
    
    # Average temperatures
    avg_temp_hot = np.mean(temp_hot)
    avg_temp_cold = np.mean(temp_cold)
    dT = avg_temp_hot - avg_temp_cold
    
    # System dimensions
    Lz = 9.0  # Distance between hot and cold regions
    area = 10.0 * 10.0  # Cross-sectional area
    
    # Calculate heat flux from energy accumulation
    # Using the fact that in steady state, energy added = energy removed
    # and the heat flux is the rate of energy transfer per unit area
    dt = 0.005  # timestep from simulation
    time = dt * 20000  # production run time
    dE = abs(temp_hot[-1] - temp_hot[0])  # Energy change
    
    # Heat flux
    J = dE / (time * area)
    
    # Temperature gradient
    dT_dz = dT / Lz
    
    # Thermal conductivity (k = -J / (dT/dz))
    k = abs(J / dT_dz)
    
    return k

# Calculate and print the thermal conductivity
k = calculate_thermal_conductivity()
print(f"{k:.6f}")  # Print with 6 decimal places

variable s2xx equal pxx

variable s2yz equal pyz

variable s4yy equal pyy

variable s4xy equal pxy
variable s4xz equal pxz
variable s4yz equal pyz

# Deformation 5 (xz)
change_box all xz delta 0.001 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable s5xx equal pxx
variable s5yy equal pyy
variable s5zz equal pzz
variable s5xy equal pxy
variable s5xz equal pxz
variable s5yz equal pyz

# Reset box
change_box all xz delta -0.001 remap

# Deformation 6 (yz)

minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# LAMMPS input script for bulk modulus calculation

# Initialize simulation
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create FCC lattice
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Initial relaxation
fix 1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix 1

# Store initial volume and energy
variable V0 equal vol
variable E0 equal pe
variable P0 equal press

# Apply volumetric strain
variable delta equal 0.001
variable nstrain equal 5

label strainloop
variable i loop ${nstrain}
    change_box all x scale $(1.0+${delta}) y scale $(1.0+${delta}) z scale $(1.0+${delta}) remap
    minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
    
    # Store energy and pressure
    variable E${i} equal pe
    variable P${i} equal press
    variable V${i} equal vol
next i
jump SELF strainloop

# Output results
print "Initial_Volume ${V0}"
print "Initial_Energy ${E0}"
print "Initial_Pressure ${P0}"

variable s loop ${nstrain}
    print "Strain_${s} ${delta}"
    print "Volume_${s} $(v_V${s})"
    print "Energy_${s} $(v_E${s})"
    print "Pressure_${s} $(v_P${s})"
next s

units metal
atom_style atomic
dimension 3
boundary p p p

# Create simulation box
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5

create_atoms 1 box

thermo 1

variable e0 equal pe
variable p0 equal press

change_box all x scale 0.99 y scale 0.99 z scale 0.99 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

variable p1 equal press

variable dv equal ${v1}-${v0}
variable dp equal ${p1}-${p0}

# Create 5x5x5 FCC lattice for Aluminum
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization with box relaxation
fix 1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix 1

# Write relaxed structure
write_data relaxed_al.data

# Apply deformations and calculate stresses
variable delta equal 0.001  # Small strain increment

# Original volume
variable v0 equal vol

# +x deformation
change_box all x delta ${delta} remap units box
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable s1 equal -pxx
variable s2 equal -pyy
variable s3 equal -pzz

# Reset box
read_data relaxed_al.data

# -x deformation
change_box all x delta -${delta} remap units box
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable s4 equal -pxx
variable s5 equal -pyy
variable s6 equal -pzz

# Calculate elastic constants
variable c11 equal (${s1}-${s4})/(2.0*${delta})
variable c12 equal (${s2}-${s5})/(2.0*${delta})
variable c13 equal (${s3}-${s6})/(2.0*${delta})

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable K equal (${c11}+2.0*${c12})/3.0

# Print results
print "Bulk Modulus (GPa) = ${K}"
